title: The Lighter Brief
overview: The big story this weekend is the nationwide flight ground stop on Friday evening. The FAA says its systems are back to full operations, but travelers, including many at Charlotte's airport, are still sorting out rebooked trips. Elsewhere, there's plenty of sports, a Queen Latifah moment ahead of her Rock Hall induction, and a delightful couple in England who scrub grimy road signs for fun.

stories.headline: Concord family safe after overnight house fire
stories.summary: A two-story home on Millstone Circle SW in Concord caught fire just after midnight Saturday. Crews arrived within five minutes and had the fire under control in under an hour. No one was hurt, and the Red Cross is helping the family, who have had to leave their home.
key_facts: Firefighters were dispatched at 12:21 a.m. and had the fire under control by 1:16 a.m.
36 firefighters from Concord and Harrisburg responded after a second alarm was called
No injuries were reported
The Concord Fire Marshal's Office is investigating the cause
stories.why: Fast work by local crews meant everyone got out safely, and the family is getting support while they recover.

stories.headline: Kickoff weekend for the Sandals St James Major League
stories.summary: Jamaica's Sandals St James Football Association Major League starts this weekend with ten teams. Defending champions Faulkland FC begin their title defense on Sunday. Three clubs from last season sat this one out, but organizers expect a competitive season.
key_facts: Saturday at WesPow Park: MoBay Boys Club vs Cambridge United (1 p.m.), then Bogue United vs Granville United (3 p.m.)
Sunday at Jarrett Park: Real MoBay AFC vs Reggae Youths FC (1 p.m.), then Wadada FC vs Faulkland FC (3 p.m.)
Lilliput Rovers, MoBay Youths and MoBay City are listed as not taking part this season
disputed: The article lists MoBay City as both dropping out and taking part, so it's unclear whether that club is in the league this season.
stories.why: Local football is back, which means a weekend of community games in St James.

links.title: Sandals St James Major League kicks off today

stories.headline: Tired travelers at Charlotte airport after the ground stop
stories.summary: After Friday's nearly five-hour nationwide ground stop, many travelers at Charlotte-Douglas spent the night on benches and floors, because rental cars and hotel rooms sold out fast. Passengers told WBTV they wished they had gotten more updates from airlines and the FAA. Several college football teams also had to adjust their travel and game plans.
key_facts: The FAA lifted the ground stop after 8 p.m. Friday
It was only the second nationwide ground stop of its kind since 9/11
Federal officials said the effects would take at least through the weekend to clear
Teams including Ole Miss, Kansas State and Utah had travel affected
stories.why: If you're flying this weekend, check your flight status before heading out and leave a little extra patience in your bag.

stories.headline: Fat Joe's former hypeman asks for a volunteer lawyer
stories.summary: Terrance Dixon, Fat Joe's former hypeman, has asked a Manhattan federal court to help him find a free volunteer lawyer. He wants to ask for a ruling without a trial in the rapper's defamation case. His previous lawyer, Tyrone Blackburn, withdrew in October. Blackburn is also named as a defendant in the case.
key_facts: Dixon filed his request on November 12, ahead of a November 13 deadline
Fat Joe sued Dixon and Blackburn in April 2025
Dixon has filed his own separate lawsuit against the rapper
Even if the court approves the request, a lawyer still has to volunteer to take the case
disputed: Fat Joe alleges Dixon and Blackburn tried to get money through false accusations. These are allegations and have not been proven in court.
Dixon's own lawsuit alleges abuse and unpaid work. Fat Joe denies these claims, and they are also unproven.
Confirmed: Blackburn's withdrawal, the court's options for Dixon, and Dixon's November 12 filing.
stories.why: It's a procedural step in an ongoing legal dispute, and none of the claims on either side has been settled.

stories.headline: College GameDay is heading to the Army-Navy game
stories.summary: ESPN's College GameDay will broadcast from MetLife Stadium for the Army-Navy game on December 12. It's the show's 10th visit to the game and its first since 2023. Starting next year, the game moves a week earlier so it doesn't clash with the expanded College Football Playoff.
key_facts: Coverage starts at 10 a.m. ET on December 12
Navy won last year's game 17-16 in Baltimore
Army is 5-4 this season and Navy is 3-6
stories.why: One of college football's most beloved traditions gets the big-stage treatment, and both coaches are glad it keeps its own date on the calendar.

stories.headline: Queen Latifah reflects ahead of her Rock Hall induction
stories.summary: Speaking to Billboard ahead of Saturday's ceremony, Queen Latifah said that for years the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame seemed to overlook Black artists. She added that it has been amazing to watch it change. She also thanked MC Lyte and Salt-N-Pepa as her 'blueprint.' MC Lyte is part of this year's class, along with Sade and Wu-Tang Clan.
key_facts: The induction ceremony is on Saturday
This year's class also includes Sade, Wu-Tang Clan and MC Lyte
Her BET documentary about her housing work in Newark, 'You Can Go Home Again,' premieres November 27
stories.why: It's a warm moment of artists honoring the people who paved the way for them.

links.title: Queen Latifah Questions Rock Hall’s Past As Her Induction Nears

stories.headline: SMU safety Ahmaad Moses may finally return to the field
stories.summary: SMU safety Ahmaad Moses had spinal fusion surgery after doctors found a herniated disk at the NFL scouting combine. He has since been fighting for a fifth year of college eligibility. He has now reportedly won temporary court relief and is expected to play against Wake Forest on Saturday. The ruling is temporary and does not settle his eligibility dispute.
key_facts: In 2025, Moses had 104 tackles and five interceptions and was named first-team All-ACC
A previous request for temporary relief was denied earlier this month
Wake Forest, Notre Dame and Stanford remain on SMU's regular-season schedule
stories.why: After surgery and months of waiting, a player who badly wanted another season may get to suit up again.

links.title: SMU Star Gets Last-Minute Breakthrough After Months Away From Field

stories.headline: Couple turns grimy road signs sparkly as a hobby
stories.summary: Paul and Ruth Richmond-Watson of Brighton, England, noticed that many local road signs were too dirty to read at night, so they started cleaning them. They now scrub at least one sign a day and post the results on Instagram at @Filthy_signs. Both are autistic with ADHD, and they say the hobby helps their mental health and lets them give back to the community.
key_facts: They started in September
Each sign takes about 20 to 25 minutes, using eco-friendly foam and a long-handled brush
They fund the work themselves, with a couple of sponsorships from supply companies
They dream of a road trip to clean signs across the UK
stories.why: It's a small, satisfying act of neighborliness that makes roads a little safer, and they're clearly having a great time doing it.

links.title: Couple with Autism and ADHD Find Passion Cleaning Filthy Street Signs
